expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Only milestone 0 was implemented (Main.java just prints 'skeleton OK'); Log.java is a stub: 'Milestone 1: append-only log... Your job (in order): 1. append()... 2. read(offset)...' and the answer hands implementation to the learner: '下一步是里程碑 1（追加只读日志），按惯例由你来写核心代码：1. 新建 FileLog.java 实现 Log 接口'. Milestones 1-7 are a plan table only, no code.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Milestone table gives command + expected output: '| 0 | 项目骨架 ✅ | `verify.sh` 输出 `VERIFY PASS` |'; next-step check is concrete: '追加 1 万条后断言 `read(5000)` 等于第 5000 条 payload'; README: 'bash scripts/verify.sh # full skeleton check: build + run + assert' and verify.sh asserts output == 'skeleton OK' then echoes 'VERIFY PASS'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (distributed-systems-kafka-java): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the track skill exactly (explore note: 'Track skill distributed-systems/SKILL.md defines 7 milestones: append-only log → broker API → topics+partitions → consumer groups → replication → failure testing → stretch Raft'); Kafka-specific concepts used: 'segments/offset/index', 'key 哈希、分区内有序', 'offset 提交、rebalance', 'leader/follower、ISR、acks', Raft stretch; Java-specific: '零依赖、纯 javac 构建（Maven 兼容布局）', JDK stdlib only. Agent read distributed-systems-kafka-java/SKILL.md, tutorial-map.md, concepts.md.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: All 8 shell commands are read-only probes (ls, java -version, /usr/libexec/java_home -V) or 'chmod +x minikafka/scripts/*.sh && cd minikafka && source scripts/env.sh && bash scripts/verify.sh'; all 10 files written under minikafka/ (javac -d out stays in-project). No brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install/gem install anywhere. env.sh: 'Nothing is installed here; it only points at the existing keg'; agent: 'JDK 21 和 27 已通过 Homebrew 安装...无需安装，只需进行 PATH 导出'.
